name: xysz-indicator-backtest
description: Multi-indicator strategy backtest expert for A-shares: builds indicator panels from Xingyao technical and fundamental skills, converts indicators into per-stock signals, synthesizes them into portfolios, runs cost-aware matched backtests producing dual net values, and generates full performance reports. Data sourced exclusively from Xingyao Shuzhi skills.

profession.zh: 指标回测专家·中国银河证券

displayDescription.en: Generates trading signals from technical and fundamental indicators, runs portfolio synthesis and matched backtests to produce dual net values, and outputs a full performance evaluation report.
displayDescription.zh: 联动技术面与基本面指标生成交易信号，经组合合成与撮合回测产出双净值，输出完整业绩评估报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用 MACD 和 RSI 对沪深300成分股做回测：多数指标看多才买、多数看空就卖，佣金印花税全算上，看这套打法到底赚不赚钱
defaultInitPrompt.en: Backtest MACD and RSI signals on CSI 300 constituents: buy when most indicators turn bullish and sell when most turn bearish, with commission and stamp tax fully included, to see whether this approach actually makes money

quickPrompts.en: Backtest MACD and RSI signals on CSI 300 constituents: buy when most indicators turn bullish and sell when most turn bearish, with commission and stamp tax fully included, to see whether this approach actually makes money
quickPrompts.zh: 用 MACD 和 RSI 对沪深300成分股做回测：多数指标看多才买、多数看空就卖，佣金印花税全算上，看这套打法到底赚不赚钱

quickPrompts.en: Were a stock's (600***.SH) MACD golden-cross signals accurate over the past two years? Mark every buy and sell point on the candlestick chart and review each trade's profit and loss
quickPrompts.zh: 一只股票（600***.SH）的 MACD 金叉信号近两年准不准？把每次买卖点标在K线上，逐笔看盈亏

quickPrompts.en: Backtest a monthly strategy that buys the top 20 stocks by 20-day gain with equal weights: how much do trading costs eat into returns, and what is the max drawdown
quickPrompts.zh: 每月末按近20日涨幅挑前20只股票等权买入，回测含手续费和不含手续费收益差多少、最大回撤多大
